Maintainer ruling 2026-11-24, record 7123091354 on #36444: 「拆成 form 类型，对外表单并入」.\n\nBlocked-by: #36868\nMetadata-protocol: added\nClause-②: no (seat to confirm at claim)\n\nGrading: `area:build` · Feature · adds the `form` metadata type and serves it · builders and administrators who author or publish forms · evidence: ADR-0159's readings at `main` `62692b7f8b`. p1 by the blocker rule (#36444 waits on card ③, which waits on this).\n\n## What to build\n\nOne releasable, additive change. Nothing an author wrote stops loading; `view` reads and old-shape writes behave as before.\n\n1. **The type** (ADR-0159 D2, D3). A `FormSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/`, derived by reference from `FormViewSchema`: `name` (qualified `OBJECT.KEY`, the part before the last segment must equal `object`), `object` (required), `label` (optional), the form body at the top level, plus `protection`, the ADR-0010 fields and the ADR-0146 `overrides` declaration. No `viewKind`, `config`, `isDefault`, `order` or `scope`. `data` is refused by name with the prescription to bind with `object`.\n2. **Registration, in one change**: the `MetadataTypeSchema` member, the `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY` row (`page`'s flags; file patterns `**/*.form.ts|yml|json`), the metadata-core lockstep enum, the type-to-schema map, the stack collection `forms` with its plural and singular map entries, and `form: listed` in `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION` (the pin in `customization-package.test.ts` fails without it). The showcase's `KIND_COVERAGE` row with one authored `form` item.\n3. **The factory**, as the maintainer accepted merge question 1 of ADR-0159. Default: `defineForm` becomes this type's factory and the Studio metadata-form helper is renamed `defineMetadataForm` (17 modules under `packages/spec/src`, one file under `ui/`), a declared compiler-carried export change. Before starting, measure use of `defineForm` outside this repository (hotcrm, cloud); a hit goes back to the seat, it is not worked around.\n4. **The projection** (D5): one pure function beside `expandViewContainer` that turns a `view` body into the `form` items it carries (the container's `form`, each `formViews` entry, a `viewKind: 'form'` item), under the name each is served as today. It is the only reader of the old shapes for form content: loader, stored-row read, doors, withdrawal judgement and lint all call it.\n5. **Reads and writes of `form`**: authored items plus projected ones, a projected item marked in its read envelope; an authored item shadows a projected one of the same name in the same package; a `form` save, reset or delete at `(package, name)` also removes the old-shape row carrying that form at that address, in the same transaction (an item-shaped `view` row deleted, a stored container re-saved without the form).\n6. **The anonymous doors and the withdrawal judgement over both types** (D6, rules 1 to 9): candidates from the effective `form` read; the withdrawal layer is the effective lists and the per-package layers of both `form` and `view`, old shapes passed through the projection first; narrowing only, in both directions; a stored body the projection cannot read closes the links it names and says so once at `error`. `404 FORM_NOT_FOUND` for a switched-off form is unchanged. The tenancy intake advisory and the organization-scoped refusal judge `form` writes too.\n7. **The public address clash**, as the maintainer accepted merge question 3. Default: the `form` write door, `os validate` and publish refuse a `form` whose open slug another form in the environment holds, naming both.\n8. **Translations** (D8): the `forms` family in the bundle schema, the extractor and the translation lint; the translator reads `forms.NAME` first and the form tails under `objects.OBJECT._views.KEY` as the declared fallback; section copy keeps `objects.OBJECT._sections.SECTION` as its object-level default.\n9. **Lint**: the form walkers read `form` items and the projection; the consumer-less warning of D1 (successor of `form-view-internal-not-loaded`).\n10. Leave the ADR id in the code, and anchor the doors' two-type read in `scripts/adr-anchors/`.\n\n## Done when\n\n- A stack with `forms: [...]` loads, serves `GET /api/v1/meta/form` and `/api/v1/meta/form/NAME`, and publishes; `os validate` refuses a name whose prefix differs from `object`, an authored `data` key, and (question 3) a taken public address.\n- A stack that still authors the three old shapes loads unchanged, and each of its forms is also served as a `form` item under the same name. `GET /api/v1/meta/view` answers exactly what it answered before (pin against a fixture taken before the change).\n- The public form of `examples/app-crm` answers at its address before and after, byte-equal on the resolve door.\n- The seven D6 pins exist, each asserting status, `code` and that no record was written, each with one ablation run recorded in the PR (rebuild, on-disk mutation proof, restore proved by an empty `git diff HEAD`):\n  - withdrawn by a `view` override in `.custom`, open as an authored `form` of the same name;\n  - the mirror (withdrawn by a `form` override, open as an old-shape item in the base);\n  - withdrawn in a container's `formViews` entry, open as a `form` item named for the expansion;\n  - withdrawn by slug after the open definition moved to another name;\n  - a per-package-layer withdrawal in either type;\n  - an unreadable old-shape body closes its links;\n  - the submit door refuses wherever the resolve door does.\n- `customization-package.test.ts` is green with the new row; the showcase coverage test is green.\n- Changeset: `minor` on every package the diff moves, `Metadata-protocol: added` in the PR body and the changeset; if question 1 landed as written, the BREAKING banner and the ADR-0087 disposition for the `defineForm` export change, with the FROM and TO mapping.\n- `packages/spec` generated artifacts regenerated and committed.\n\n## Not in this card\n\n- No tombstone, no conversion, no stored-row ceremony (card ⑤).\n- No console change (card ③). The shipped console keeps working against `view`.\n- No move of example or HotCRM sources beyond the one showcase item (card ④).\n\n## Security\n\nThe doors change which metadata type they read an anonymous admission from. A dev that finds a way to re-open a withdrawn form reports it through the private channel and stops; it is not fixed in passing. Contract-tier review is required on this PR.\n\nDedupe words: form metadata type, forms collection, anonymous form doors both types, withdrawal projection, defineForm rename."
